split_method: q01-q20 development (20); q21-q25 test (5). Five new test questions cover different source passages from the old test, before any retrieval of these new questions.
leakage_risk: Both splits share corpus documents and broad topics. q21-q25 are new questions on different source passages from the old test, but not an unseen-document evaluation. Five questions are a small educational holdout.
filter_origin: Every filter is an explicit year stated in the question before retrieval. Gold source IDs, pages, answers and evidence are never used in encoding or search filters.
alternative_evidence_policy: Primary and listed alternative quotes are accepted. Additional equivalent evidence requires reviewed labels with source/page, supporting quote, reviewer and justification. Automatic matching and manual grounding are reported separately.
holdout_policy: Select from dev before test retrieval. Test-informed changes invalidate independent holdout claims and require disclosure and a fresh test set.
authoring: Questions and source evidence were drafted and checked with Codex.
creation_scope: Revision 2 is frozen before its own retrieval. Previously retrieved q01-q20 are development data; only q21-q25 form the fresh test.

revision.previous_test_disposition: Moved to development after exposure; not reused as independent test.
changes: Source-checked alternative evidence and clearer question scope.
Fresh q21-q25 test; no changes to corpus, model or A/B/C parameters.
Cross-corpus source audit found equivalent q25 definitions on overview page 17, added before any fresh-test retrieval.

gold_verification.method: Primary and alternative quotes checked against normalized physical PDF pages, answer support and question-provided filter scope.

strategy_extension.basis: The 1000-character paragraph/sentence D/E experiment was replaced with semantic D. Earlier dev results were observed; q21-q25 have not been retrieved.

replacement.D: Semantic boundaries using real buffered BGE-M3 source-sentence embeddings, a corpus-wide 90th-percentile cosine-distance threshold, minimum 100 characters before semantic cuts, maximum 500 characters and zero overlap; no metadata filter.

strategy_extension.hypothesis: Semantic boundaries may improve topic coherence and evidence retrieval at the same character cap as B, but can fragment evidence and add preprocessing cost. B-D compare chunking; B-C retain the controlled filter comparison.
strategy_extension.threshold_policy: Percentile, buffer and size limits fixed before this run. Threshold uses only source-text distances across the selected corpus, never questions, answers or retrieval scores.
strategy_extension.unchanged: Corpus, normalization, A/B/C settings, retrieval model, 25 questions/gold, split and selection rule.
strategy_extension.evaluation: A/B/C/D are compared on the same 20 dev questions and selected before fresh-test retrieval. The evidence metric scores the actual returned chunk. Coherence and grounding use separate manual assessments.
